blockContainer.p:
Directive 2009/43/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 May 2009 simplifying the terms and conditions of transfers of defence-related products within the Community
OJ L 146, 10.6.2009, p. 1. empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts amending the list of defence- related products set out in the Annex. Pursuant to Article 13 of Directive2009/43/EC, the Annex must strictly correspond to the Common Military List of the European Union.

The Common Military List of the European Union was last updated by the Council on 20 February 2023
OJ C 72, 28.2.2023, p. 2-37.. To date, the Annex has not been aligned with the latest amendment of the Common Military List. It is necessary to do so through the adoption of a delegated act.

tblock.heading: CONSULTATIONS PRIOR TO THE ADOPTION OF THE ACT

blockContainer.p: Pursuant to Article 13a(4) of Directive 2009/43/EC, before adopting a delegated act amending the Annex to Directive 2009/43/EC, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making.

Consultations were carried out with the Members of the expert group on EU Transfers of Defence-related Products. Comments received from the experts from the Member States have been duly taken into account in the drafting of the Commission Delegated Directive.

The Directive does not foresee a feedback mechanism on the basis of the Better Regulation rules due to the purely technical nature of the Annex’ alignment with the Common Military List, in which the Commission cannot exercise any discretion.

tblock.heading: LEGAL ELEMENTS OF THE DELEGATED ACT

blockContainer.p:
Directive 2009/43/EC has been amended by Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union
OJ L 198, 25.7.2019, p. 241.. The exercise of the delegation has been laid down in the new Article 13a of Directive 2009/43/EC.

Article 1 of the Delegated Directive provides that the Annex to Directive 2009/43/EC is replaced by the Annex to the Delegated Directive, whose content is identical to the Common Military List as last updated by the Council.

Article 2 lays down the deadlines by which Member States are required to adopt, publish and apply the necessary transposition measures and requires them to communicate to the Commission the text of those provisions as well as the text of the main provisions of national law which they adopt in the field covered by the Delegated Directive.
